ZTH (Zero Hallucination Tolerance) is an AI behavior safety mechanism. Stricter tiers require more frequent user confirmation before the AI executes tools or plans. Hallucination triggers (tool output / plan / skill body) always prompt regardless of tier. Performance class controls whether LLM final check runs; low-end devices can disable it for speed.
